note: A theme sets palette, font and default transition for a whole video. compose.py stamps it into the storyboard spec and into themeable catalog scenes, so the same archetype looks different per theme. Fonts are system stacks (no web-font download needed). titleAdvance keeps the title fit math safe for wider fonts.

midnight-lime.label: Midnight lime — the original dark/acid-green editorial look

paper-ink.label: Paper & ink — light, warm, serif editorial (print feel)

terminal-green.label: Terminal — near-black with phosphor green, monospace (hacker/dev)

sunset-warm.label: Sunset — deep plum with warm orange (friendly, energetic)

cyber-magenta.label: Cyber — ink-blue black with hot magenta (bold product/tech)

mono-noir.label: Mono noir — pure black & white, no color (minimal, severe)

ocean-steel.label: Ocean steel — deep teal-navy with cyan (calm, corporate-clean)

royal-gold.label: Royal gold — near-black brown with warm gold serif (premium, luxe)

electric-indigo.label: Electric indigo — violet-black with soft purple (modern SaaS)
